condition_description: 25 knot apparent wind on the beam (90 deg off the bow), wind from the ama side
notes: Apparent wind is what the boat feels (masthead anemometer), measured off the bow: 0=head-to-wind, 90=beam, 180=dead downwind. trim is 'worst_case' (any sheeting the rig allows, e.g. over-sheeted in a gust) or 'max_drive' (sail set for maximum driving force). Sail force coefficients come from the sail polar passed to operating_envelope (--sail-polar, default constant/sail_polar/placeholder.json) - see src/structural/sail_aero.py.
